blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Chapter

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈1085〉 與 〈85〉 的關係：〈85〉 是法定檢驗方法，〈1085〉 是實務操作的詳細指引
blocks.en: Understand the relationship between USP <1085> and <85>: <85> is the compendial test method, while <1085> is the detailed guide to practical application

blocks.zh: 認識熱原（Pyrogen）與細菌內毒素（Endotoxin）的本質差異
blocks.en: Understand the essential difference between pyrogens and bacterial endotoxins

blocks.zh: 掌握內毒素參考標準品（RSE）與對照標準內毒素（CSE）的校正原理
blocks.en: Grasp the calibration principle linking the Reference Standard Endotoxin (RSE) and the Control Standard Endotoxin (CSE)

blocks.zh: 學會使用 K/M 公式計算藥品的內毒素限值
blocks.en: Learn to calculate a drug product's endotoxin limit using the K/M formula

blocks.zh: 理解不同給藥途徑對 K 值的影響，以及內毒素限值表的實務應用
blocks.en: Understand how the route of administration affects the K value, and how the endotoxin limit table is applied in practice

blocks.zh: Introduction — 緒論
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 導師解析
blocks.en: Mentor Notes

blocks.zh: 核心概念：〈85〉 vs 〈1085〉 的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept: How <85> and <1085> Are Positioned

blocks.zh: USP 章節編號有個重要規則：
blocks.en: USP chapter numbering follows an important rule:

blocks.zh: 〈85〉（編號 < 1000） — 強制性法定檢驗方法，所有上市藥品必須遵循
blocks.en: <85> (number < 1000) - a mandatory, compendial test method that all marketed drug products must follow

blocks.zh: 〈1085〉（編號 ≥ 1000） — 資訊性指引章節，提供實務操作的詳細背景與建議
blocks.en: <1085> (number ≥ 1000) - an informational guidance chapter that provides detailed background and recommendations for practical application

blocks.zh: 兩者的關係就是「考試規則」與「考試攻略」的區別。〈85〉 告訴你「怎麼考」，〈1085〉 教你「怎麼考得好」。
blocks.en: The relationship is like "exam rules" versus "exam strategy." <85> tells you how the test is done; <1085> teaches you how to do it well.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 駕照考試的規則與教練手冊：
blocks.en: Driving test rules vs. the instructor's handbook:

blocks.zh: 〈85〉 就像交通法規考試 — 所有要考駕照的人都必須遵守這些規則，沒有例外。而 〈1085〉 就像駕訓班的教練手冊 — 它不是法律，但裡面有豐富的經驗和技巧，幫助你在實際路況中安全駕駛。
blocks.en: <85> is like the traffic-law exam - everyone taking the driving test must follow these rules, with no exceptions. <1085> is like the driving school instructor's handbook - it is not law, but it is full of experience and techniques that help you drive safely in real traffic.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的日常 QC 工作中，分析師每天做的是 〈85〉 規定的試驗，但遇到問題（例如干擾因素、限值計算、OOS 調查）時，就需要翻閱 〈1085〉 來找到解決方案。
blocks.en: In day-to-day QC work at a CDMO, analysts run the tests specified in <85>, but when problems arise (for example interfering factors, limit calculations, or OOS investigations), you need to turn to <1085> to find solutions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示
blocks.en: Key Points

blocks.zh: 三大藥典協調：〈85〉 自 2002 年起與日本藥典（JP）和歐洲藥典（Ph.Eur.）協調一致。這意味著全球使用同一套 BET 方法學，這對 CDMO 來說是個好消息 — 你不需要為不同客戶準備不同的 BET 方法。
blocks.en: Harmonization among the three pharmacopeias: Since 2002, <85> has been harmonized with the Japanese Pharmacopoeia (JP) and the European Pharmacopoeia (Ph. Eur.). This means one BET methodology is used worldwide, which is good news for a CDMO - you do not need to prepare a different BET method for each client.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 選擇在 〈85〉 之外另設 〈1085〉？直接把所有內容寫進 〈85〉 不是更方便嗎？
blocks.en: Why did USP create <1085> separately from <85>? Wouldn't it be more convenient to put everything into <85>?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 工廠同時供應歐洲、美國、日本市場，三方藥典的協調對你的 BET 驗證策略有什麼影響？
blocks.en: If your CDMO site supplies the European, US, and Japanese markets at the same time, how does harmonization among the three pharmacopeias affect your BET validation strategy?

blocks.zh: Background: Pyrogens and Endotoxins — 熱原與內毒素背景
blocks.en: Background: Pyrogens and Endotoxins

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Pyrogen vs Endotoxin
blocks.en: Core Concept: Pyrogen vs. Endotoxin

blocks.zh: Pyrogen（熱原）：任何能引起發燒反應的物質統稱。範圍很廣，包括：
blocks.en: Pyrogen: a collective term for any substance that can cause a fever response. The range is broad and includes:

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素（最常見、最強效）
blocks.en: Bacterial endotoxin (the most common and most potent)

blocks.zh: 某些蛋白質（如細胞因子）
blocks.en: Certain proteins (such as cytokines)

blocks.zh: 某些化學物質
blocks.en: Certain chemical substances

blocks.zh: Endotoxin（內毒素）：特指革蘭氏陰性菌（GNB）細胞壁外膜的成分。它是熱原的一個子集，也是製藥業最關注的熱原類型。
blocks.en: Endotoxin: specifically a component of the outer membrane of the cell wall of Gram-negative bacteria (GNB). It is a subset of pyrogens and the type of pyrogen the pharmaceutical industry is most concerned about.

blocks.zh: 「無菌」不等於「無內毒素」：
blocks.en: "Sterile" does not mean "endotoxin-free":

blocks.zh: 想像一棟房子發生了火災（細菌繁殖）。火撲滅後（滅菌），房子變得安全了（無菌）。但是火災留下的灰燼和殘骸（內毒素）仍然散落在各處。你走進這棟房子不會被燒傷，但可能會被灰塵和殘骸嗆到。
blocks.en: Imagine a house that caught fire (bacterial growth). After the fire is put out (sterilization), the house is safe (sterile). But the ash and debris left by the fire (endotoxin) are still scattered everywhere. Walking into the house will not burn you, but you may choke on the dust and debris.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼在 CDMO 中，滅菌和除熱原是兩個獨立的控制步驟。一個產品通過了無菌試驗，不代表它就沒有內毒素污染。
blocks.en: This is why, at a CDMO, sterilization and depyrogenation are two separate control steps. A product that passes the sterility test is not necessarily free of endotoxin contamination.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：內毒素來源地圖
blocks.en: Key Points: Map of Endotoxin Sources

blocks.zh: 原文列出了製程中內毒素的六大來源，這也是 OOS 調查時的排查重點：
blocks.en: The original text lists six major sources of endotoxin in the process, which are also the focus areas when investigating an OOS:

blocks.zh: 水系統 — 最常見的來源，WFI 品質至關重要
blocks.en: Water systems - the most common source; WFI quality is critical

blocks.zh: 原料藥（API） — 特別是生物來源的原料
blocks.en: Active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) - especially materials of biological origin

blocks.zh: 賦形劑 — 天然來源的糖類、肝素等風險較高
blocks.en: Excipients - sugars, heparin, and other natural-source materials carry a higher risk

blocks.zh: 原物料（天然來源） — 需要供應商管控
blocks.en: Raw materials (natural origin) - require supplier control

blocks.zh: 包裝材料 — 直接接觸產品的容器/塞子
blocks.en: Packaging materials - containers/stoppers in direct contact with the product

blocks.zh: 設備清潔/儲存不當 — 製程管控的重要環節
blocks.en: Improper equipment cleaning/storage - an important element of process control

blocks.zh: 為什麼「無菌但仍含有內毒素」這個概念對 CDMO 的品質管制特別重要？請舉一個實際場景。
blocks.en: Why is the concept of "sterile but still containing endotoxin" especially important for CDMO quality control? Give a real-life scenario.

blocks.zh: 在你的工廠中，哪一個內毒素來源最可能導致批次失敗？你會如何排序調查優先順序？
blocks.en: At your site, which endotoxin source is most likely to cause a batch failure? How would you prioritize the investigation?

blocks.zh: Endotoxins — 內毒素的科學本質
blocks.en: Endotoxins: The Science Behind Them

blocks.zh: 核心概念：LPS 結構與標準品的差異
blocks.en: Core Concept: LPS Structure and How Standards Differ

blocks.zh: 天然內毒素 vs 純化 LPS 標準品：
blocks.en: Natural endotoxin vs. purified LPS standards:

blocks.zh: 天然內毒素 — 存在於 GNB 外膜上，與蛋白質、磷脂等形成複合物。以 OMV（外膜囊泡）或碎片形式釋出
blocks.en: Natural endotoxin - present in the outer membrane of GNB, forming complexes with proteins, phospholipids, and other components. It is released as outer membrane vesicles (OMVs) or fragments

blocks.zh: RSE/CSE 標準品 — 透過 Westphal 熱酚法提取並純化的 LPS，已去除蛋白質等成分。在自然界中不存在這種形態
blocks.en: RSE/CSE standards - LPS extracted and purified by the Westphal hot-phenol method, with proteins and other components removed. This form does not exist in nature

blocks.zh: 這個差異非常關鍵：你用來校正和驗證的標準品，與你實際要檢測的污染物，在物理化學性質上可能有顯著差異。
blocks.en: This difference is critical: the standards you use for calibration and validation may differ significantly in physicochemical properties from the contaminants you actually need to detect.

blocks.zh: 訓練用假人 vs 真人：
blocks.en: Training mannequin vs. a real person:

blocks.zh: RSE/CSE 就像急救訓練用的假人 — 它們被設計來模擬真人，讓你能標準化地練習和測試。但假人畢竟不是真人，某些在假人上練習有效的技術，面對真實傷患時可能需要調整。
blocks.en: RSE/CSE are like first-aid training mannequins - they are designed to simulate a real person so you can practice and test in a standardized way. But a mannequin is not a real person, and some techniques that work well on a mannequin may need adjustment on a real patient.

blocks.zh: 同樣地，你用 CSE spike 做的回收率試驗結果很漂亮，不代表你的方法對天然內毒素污染有同樣的檢測效率。這就是「低內毒素回收」（LER）現象的核心爭議。
blocks.en: Likewise, excellent recovery results from a CSE spike do not mean your method detects natural endotoxin contamination with the same efficiency. This is the core of the controversy over the "low endotoxin recovery" (LER) phenomenon.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 的實務衝擊
blocks.en: Key Points: Practical Impact for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對生物製劑的影響：生物藥品（單株抗體、蛋白質藥物等）的基質複雜，天然內毒素在這些基質中的行為可能與純化 LPS 標準品截然不同。這是近年 LER（Low Endotoxin Recovery）爭議的根源 — 在 Section 3 會深入討論。
blocks.en: Impact on biologics: Biological drug products (monoclonal antibodies, protein drugs, etc.) have complex matrices, and natural endotoxin may behave very differently in these matrices from purified LPS standards. This is the root of the recent LER (Low Endotoxin Recovery) controversy, discussed in depth in Section 3.

blocks.zh: 日常啟示：做 BET 方法適用性試驗時，不要只滿足於「通過了 CSE spike 回收」。要思考你的產品基質是否可能影響天然內毒素的檢測行為。
blocks.en: Day-to-day takeaway: When performing BET suitability tests, do not settle for "passing CSE spike recovery." Consider whether your product matrix could affect how natural endotoxin is detected.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 在 〈1085〉 中特別提到標準品可能「與天然內毒素反應不同」？這對你的 BET 驗證策略有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does USP specifically note in <1085> that standards may "react differently from natural endotoxin"? How does this affect your BET validation strategy?

blocks.zh: 如果客戶要求你使用「天然內毒素」做 hold time study 的 spike，你會怎麼設計實驗？會遇到什麼挑戰？
blocks.en: If a client asks you to use "natural endotoxin" to spike a hold time study, how would you design the experiment? What challenges would you face?

blocks.zh: RSE: CSE Calibration — 標準品校正
blocks.en: RSE: CSE Calibration

blocks.zh: 核心概念：EU 單位與校正鏈
blocks.en: Core Concept: EU Units and the Calibration Chain

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要 EU 而不用質量單位？
blocks.en: Why use EU rather than mass units?

blocks.zh: 不同菌株的 LPS 即使質量相同，引起的發熱反應可能天差地別。EU 是一個「活性單位」，把不同來源的 LPS 統一到「引起相同生物反應」的基準上。
blocks.en: Even at the same mass, LPS from different bacterial strains can cause very different fever responses. The EU is an "activity unit" that brings LPS from different sources onto a common basis of "causing the same biological response."

blocks.zh: 校正鏈層級：
blocks.en: Levels of the calibration chain:

blocks.zh: WHO 國際標準品 → 最頂層
blocks.en: WHO International Standard → the top level

blocks.zh: RSE（USP 參考標準品） → 一級標準，由 E. coli 0113:H10:K 製備
blocks.en: RSE (USP Reference Standard Endotoxin) → primary standard, prepared from E. coli 0113:H10:K

blocks.zh: CSE（對照標準內毒素） → 二級標準，由試劑廠商提供
blocks.en: CSE (Control Standard Endotoxin) → secondary standard, supplied by the reagent manufacturer

blocks.zh: 公式解析：CSE 效價計算
blocks.en: Formula Breakdown: Calculating CSE Potency

blocks.zh: 凝膠法（Gel-Clot）：
blocks.en: Gel-clot method:

blocks.zh: 定量法（Kinetic/Endpoint）：
blocks.en: Quantitative methods (kinetic/endpoint):

blocks.zh: 關鍵規則：每個 lysate lot × CSE lot 的組合都需要獨立校正。換了其中任何一個批號，就必須重新做校正。
blocks.en: Key rule: Every combination of lysate lot × CSE lot requires its own calibration. If either lot number changes, calibration must be repeated.

blocks.zh: 秤子的校正：
blocks.en: Calibrating a scale:

blocks.zh: 想像你有一把電子秤（lysate），還有一袋標準砝碼（CSE）。你需要先用國家級的認證砝碼（RSE）來校正你的秤，確定它量的準。然後再用你的秤來「秤」那袋砝碼，確認它的真實重量。
blocks.en: Imagine you have an electronic scale (the lysate) and a bag of reference weights (the CSE). You first calibrate your scale with nationally certified weights (the RSE) to make sure it measures accurately. Then you use your scale to "weigh" that bag of weights to confirm their true weight.

blocks.zh: 但如果你換了一把新秤（新批號的 lysate），即使砝碼沒換，你也必須重新校正 — 因為每把秤的靈敏度不同。
blocks.en: But if you switch to a new scale (a new lysate lot), you must recalibrate even if the weights have not changed - because every scale has a different sensitivity.

blocks.zh: Table 1 的數據解讀：注意四個 CSE 稀釋度的 EU/ng 結果分別是 15、12、12、14。這些值有一定的離散度，但平均值 13.25 被「向下取整」為 13 EU/ng — 這是因為取整規則要求保守估計（不過度宣稱效價）。
blocks.en: Interpreting the Table 1 data: Note that the EU/ng results for the four CSE dilutions are 15, 12, 12, and 14. These values show some scatter, but the mean of 13.25 is "rounded down" to 13 EU/ng - because the rounding rule calls for a conservative estimate (not overstating potency).

blocks.zh: CDMO 日常：大多數 CDMO 實驗室使用試劑廠商（如 Charles River、Lonza）提供的 kit，CSE 校正數據會附在 CoA 中。但你必須理解背後的原理，才能在 OOS 調查時判斷是否是試劑問題。
blocks.en: CDMO daily practice: Most CDMO laboratories use kits from reagent manufacturers (such as Charles River or Lonza), and the CSE calibration data are provided on the CoA. But you must understand the principle behind it so that, during an OOS investigation, you can judge whether the reagent is the problem.

blocks.zh: 如果你的實驗室同時使用凝膠法和動態比濁法，同一批 CSE 在兩種方法中的效價會一樣嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your laboratory uses both the gel-clot method and the kinetic turbidimetric method, will the same CSE lot have the same potency in both methods? Why?

blocks.zh: 你收到新批號的 LAL 試劑盒，CoA 上寫著 CSE 效價為 15 EU/ng。你需要做什麼驗證才能開始使用？
blocks.en: You receive a new lot of LAL reagent kit, and the CoA states a CSE potency of 15 EU/ng. What verification do you need to perform before you can start using it?

blocks.zh: Calculating Endotoxin Limits — 內毒素限值計算
blocks.en: Calculating Endotoxin Limits

blocks.zh: 核心概念：K/M 公式的意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: What the K/M Formula Means

blocks.zh: 內毒素限值公式的邏輯其實很直觀：
blocks.en: The logic of the endotoxin limit formula is actually quite intuitive:

blocks.zh: K（分子） — 人體能安全承受的最大內毒素量。靜脈注射為 5 EU/kg，脊髓腔注射僅 0.2 EU/kg（因為腦脊液對內毒素極度敏感）
blocks.en: K (numerator) - the maximum amount of endotoxin the human body can safely tolerate. It is 5 EU/kg for intravenous injection, but only 0.2 EU/kg for intrathecal injection (because cerebrospinal fluid is extremely sensitive to endotoxin)

blocks.zh: M（分母） — 每小時每公斤體重給予的最大藥物劑量。劑量越大，每單位藥物允許的內毒素就越少
blocks.en: M (denominator) - the maximum dose of drug given per kilogram of body weight per hour. The larger the dose, the less endotoxin is allowed per unit of drug

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：劑量越大 → M 越大 → 限值越嚴格。給藥途徑越敏感 → K 越小 → 限值越嚴格。
blocks.en: Core logic: The larger the dose → the larger M → the stricter the limit. The more sensitive the route of administration → the smaller K → the stricter the limit.

blocks.zh: 公式實例計算
blocks.en: Worked Example of the Formula

blocks.zh: 案例：一個 IV 注射的蛋白質藥物，成人最大劑量為 10 mg/kg/h
blocks.en: Case: An IV-injected protein drug with a maximum adult dose of 10 mg/kg/h

blocks.zh: 轉換為 EU/mL：如果產品濃度為 50 mg/mL
blocks.en: Converting to EU/mL: if the product concentration is 50 mg/mL

blocks.zh: 這意味著每 mL 產品中最多允許含有 25 EU 的內毒素。
blocks.en: This means each mL of product may contain at most 25 EU of endotoxin.

blocks.zh: 飲酒限量的概念：
blocks.en: The concept of a drinking limit:

blocks.zh: 內毒素限值就像喝酒的「安全量」。K 是你的身體能承受的酒精總量（體重越重能承受越多）。M 是你喝的飲料有多「烈」（劑量越大，每杯允許的酒精含量就越低）。
blocks.en: The endotoxin limit is like a "safe amount" of alcohol. K is the total amount of alcohol your body can tolerate (the heavier you are, the more you can handle). M is how "strong" the drink is (the larger the dose, the lower the alcohol content allowed per glass).

blocks.zh: 脊髓腔注射就像「空腹喝烈酒」— 身體對毒素的耐受度只有靜脈注射的 1/25（0.2 vs 5 EU/kg），所以限值極其嚴格。
blocks.en: Intrathecal injection is like "drinking hard liquor on an empty stomach" - the body's tolerance for the toxin is only 1/25 that of intravenous injection (0.2 vs. 5 EU/kg), so the limit is extremely strict.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 必知的實務細節
blocks.en: Key Points: Practical Details Every CDMO Must Know

blocks.zh: 最保守原則：多個適應症/給藥途徑時，選最嚴格的限值
blocks.en: Most conservative principle: With multiple indications/routes of administration, choose the strictest limit

blocks.zh: 小兒劑量優先：如果兒童的 mg/kg 劑量高於成人，必須用兒童劑量計算
blocks.en: Pediatric dose takes priority: If the pediatric mg/kg dose is higher than the adult dose, the pediatric dose must be used in the calculation

blocks.zh: 體重差異：美國用 70 kg，日本用 60 kg — 出口日本的產品限值會更嚴格
blocks.en: Body weight differences: The US uses 70 kg and Japan uses 60 kg - the limit for a product exported to Japan will be stricter

blocks.zh: 早期開發：新藥開發初期就應計算內毒素限值，即使劑量尚未確定，也要用預期最高劑量計算
blocks.en: Early development: The endotoxin limit should be calculated at the start of new drug development; even if the dose has not yet been determined, calculate it using the expected highest dose

blocks.zh: 一個既可 IV 又可 IT 給藥的產品，IT 劑量為 0.5 mg/kg/h。請計算兩種途徑的內毒素限值，並說明應使用哪一個。
blocks.en: A product can be given both IV and IT, with an IT dose of 0.5 mg/kg/h. Calculate the endotoxin limit for both routes and explain which one should be used.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 客戶生產一個眼科注射劑（intraocular），同時也開發 IV 適應症。如何確定產品的內毒素限值？
blocks.en: Your CDMO client manufactures an intraocular injection and is also developing an IV indication. How do you determine the product's endotoxin limit?

blocks.zh: 日本客戶與美國客戶委託你生產相同產品，為什麼日本的內毒素限值可能更嚴格？
blocks.en: A Japanese client and a US client commission you to manufacture the same product. Why might the Japanese endotoxin limit be stricter?

blocks.zh: Special Limit Considerations — 特殊限值情境
blocks.en: Special Limit Considerations

blocks.zh: 核心概念：限值的「分拆」邏輯
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Logic of "Apportioning" Limits

blocks.zh: 內毒素限值的核心思維是「追溯分配」：
blocks.en: The core thinking behind endotoxin limits is "back-allocation":

blocks.zh: 先計算最終產品的限值
blocks.en: First calculate the limit for the finished product

blocks.zh: 再反推分配給每個原料/組件的個別限值
blocks.en: Then work backward to allocate an individual limit to each raw material/component

blocks.zh: 確保即使每個組件都在其限值邊緣，最終產品仍不超標
blocks.en: Ensure that even if every component is at the edge of its limit, the finished product still does not exceed its limit

blocks.zh: 如果同一原料用於多個產品配方，應採用最嚴格的限值來管控該原料。
blocks.en: If the same raw material is used in multiple product formulations, the strictest limit should be applied to control that raw material.

blocks.zh: 家庭預算分配：
blocks.en: Household budget allocation:

blocks.zh: 想像你的月收入是固定的（= K 值）。你需要把這筆錢分配給房租、伙食、交通等各項支出（= 各原料/組件的內毒素貢獻）。你不能讓任何一項支出超過預算上限，否則整體就會「超支」（= 超過內毒素限值）。
blocks.en: Imagine your monthly income is fixed (= the K value). You need to allocate this money to rent, food, transportation, and other expenses (= the endotoxin contribution of each raw material/component). You cannot let any single expense exceed its budget cap, or you will "overspend" overall (= exceed the endotoxin limit).

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器（prefilled syringe）就像「套餐」— 藥品和注射器的內毒素貢獻要一起算在產品限值裡。
blocks.en: A prefilled syringe is like a "set meal" - the endotoxin contributions of the drug and the syringe must be counted together within the product limit.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：葡聚醣干擾
blocks.en: Key Points: Glucan Interference

blocks.zh: Glucan blocker 的重要性：天然來源的材料（糖類、肝素、酵素）可能含有 β-glucan（葡聚醣），這種物質會活化 LAL 反應中的 Factor G 路徑，造成「假陽性」。Glucan blocker 能封鎖這個非特異性路徑，確保試驗只測到真正的內毒素。
blocks.en: The importance of glucan blockers: Materials of natural origin (sugars, heparin, enzymes) may contain β-glucan, which activates the Factor G pathway in the LAL reaction and causes "false positives." A glucan blocker blocks this non-specific pathway so that the test measures only true endotoxin.

blocks.zh: CDMO 提醒：如果你的客戶產品含有天然來源的賦形劑（如蔗糖、海藻糖），在方法適用性試驗中一定要考慮是否需要使用 glucan blocker。
blocks.en: CDMO reminder: If your client's product contains naturally sourced excipients (such as sucrose or trehalose), always consider whether a glucan blocker is needed in the method suitability test.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 接到一個預填充注射器（prefilled syringe）產品的訂單。如何設計內毒素檢測策略？需要分開測試注射器和藥液嗎？
blocks.en: Your CDMO receives an order for a prefilled syringe product. How do you design the endotoxin testing strategy? Do the syringe and the drug solution need to be tested separately?

blocks.zh: 一個 kit 包含凍乾藥品 + 稀釋液 + 注射器，三者的內毒素如何整合計算？
blocks.en: A kit contains a lyophilized drug product + diluent + syringe. How do you combine the endotoxin of the three in the calculation?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 〈1085〉 的定位：USP 〈85〉 的實務操作指引，提供 BET 方法的背景知識、計算方法和疑難解答
blocks.en: Positioning of <1085>: A practical guide to USP <85>, providing background knowledge, calculation methods, and troubleshooting for the BET method

blocks.zh: 無菌 ≠ 無內毒素：滅菌後殘留的細胞碎片仍可能含有活性內毒素 — 這是製程管控的核心觀念
blocks.en: Sterile ≠ endotoxin-free: Cell debris remaining after sterilization may still contain active endotoxin - this is a core concept in process control

blocks.zh: RSE/CSE 校正：每個 lysate lot × CSE lot 的組合都需要獨立校正，以確保試驗結果的可靠性
blocks.en: RSE/CSE calibration: Every combination of lysate lot × CSE lot requires independent calibration to ensure the reliability of test results

blocks.zh: K/M 公式：Endotoxin Limit = K/M，三個變數決定限值 — 給藥途徑（K）、劑量（M）、體重
blocks.en: K/M formula: Endotoxin Limit = K/M; three variables determine the limit - route of administration (K), dose (M), and body weight

blocks.zh: 最保守原則：多適應症/多給藥途徑時，選擇最嚴格的限值作為產品規格
blocks.en: Most conservative principle: With multiple indications/routes of administration, choose the strictest limit as the product specification

blocks.zh: 組件分配：從產品限值反推各組件的個別限值，確保「加總不超標」
blocks.en: Component allocation: Work backward from the product limit to individual component limits to ensure the "total does not exceed the limit"
